segments.title: Grunchmas Cold Open: The Horny Grinch Ballad
segments.notes: Case Blackwell debuts as The Grunch, a horny Grinch variant, performing an original song establishing the Fucks List premise.

segments.title: Grunchmas Fucks List: Population Judgment
segments.notes: The Grunch adjudicates a massive community-submitted roster of pop culture figures, fictional characters, and network personalities into 'Fucks' or 'Doesn't Fuck' categories with surreal commentary.

segments.title: The Night Before Crumsmas: Crowdsourced Slam Poetry
segments.notes: Crum delivers a freestyle Christmas poem from Whoville, heavily reliant on chat to supply rhymes, culminating in a degenerate holiday moral.

segments.title: Chet Manscape Christmas Cameo
segments.notes: Chet appears as 'Trent' for a brief holiday check-in, discussing fitness spirituality and wishing Feliz Navajo before vanishing.

segments.title: Pepito Check-In: Neutered Dog in a Jean Coat
segments.notes: Pepito appears in a Christmas jean coat with green paint in his eyes, confirms neutering, and sings a mournful carol before departing.

segments.title: Fucksmas Train Derailment
segments.notes: Hype Train manifests as the Fucksmas Train, powered by the idea of sex rather than sex itself, laments exclusion from the Whoville orgy, and recalls devil stick hobby.

segments.title: Lyrical Fucksmas: Freestyle Rap Adjudication
segments.notes: The Grunch speed-runs the remaining Fucks List entries via improvised rap over shifting beats, covering Undertaker, Edward Scissorhands, Falcor, Fivel, Michigan J. Frog, and the Twilight cast.

segments.title: Christmas Miracle Debate: Munch Apologizes to Crum
segments.notes: Munch returns unannounced; a chat poll forces him to apologize to Crum on air, prompting a fragile truce and Munch's agreement to return to the show.

segments.title: Grunchmas Sign-Off & Raid
segments.notes: The Grunch declares the Fucks List complete, describes his annual hibernation-death-resurrection cycle, claims a fake orgy invite, and raids re_re.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: anchor. Hosts as The Grunch, a horny Grinch persona, running the annual Fucks List and mediating the Munch-Crum Christmas truce.

characters.name: Crum
characters.notes: debate analyst. Delivers the crowdsourced 'Night Before Crumsmas' poem from Whoville and receives a forced on-air apology from Munch.

characters.name: Munch
characters.notes: debate analyst. Crashes the Grunch cave, loses a chat poll, apologizes to Crum under duress, and agrees to return to the network.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Checks in wearing a jean coat with green paint in his eyes, confirms neutering, and sings a depressing carol.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: musical correspondent. Manifests as the Fucksmas Train, laments missing the Whoville orgy, and recalls a devil stick hobby.

characters.name: Chet Manscape
characters.notes: science correspondent. Briefly appears as 'Trent' for a Christmas cameo discussing fitness spirituality.

characters.name: Liliana
characters.notes: desk partner. Evaluated on the Fucks List; ruled 'only mental domination' and placed on Doesn't Fuck.

characters.name: Jeff Ripple
characters.notes: human-interest reporter. Referenced via his adult son appearing on the Fucks List; Jeff himself left off-list pending judgment.

storylines.beat: [2023-12-18] Munch returns unannounced, loses a chat poll 57-43, and is forced to apologize to Crum on air, agreeing to return to the show in a Christmas truce.

lore_notes.fact: Performs annual Grunchmas stream as 'The Grunch,' a horny Grinch variant who maintains a Fucks List of pop culture figures.
Delivers the annual 'Night Before Crumsmas' freestyle poem from Whoville, relying on chat for rhymes.
Confirmed neutered; owner is Fiona Nova; wears a Christmas jean coat and gets green paint in his eyes.
Agrees to return to the network after forced on-air apology to Crum; claims the show was 'easier than ever' without him.
Appears as 'Trent' for a Christmas cameo, discusses fitness as spiritual practice, wishes 'Feliz Navajo.'

episode_summary: The Grunch presides over the annual Fucks List, adjudicating hundreds of submissions into horny/non-horny categories while Crum delivers a chat-assisted slam poem from Whoville. The broadcast culminates in a surprise Munch & Crum debate where chat forces Munch to apologize to Crun, securing Munch's return to the network in a tenuous Christmas truce.
